auditor_only.available_is_not_assumed: Values summarize last observed content, not a guarantee of present access. Check actual teacher ledger before interpreting any deliberate revision as a retention failure.
auditor_only.numeric_provider: At least one native provider and zero external arithmetic calls is required to label a successful arithmetic sample native; field labels alone are insufficient.
auditor_only.comparisons: Prior main comparator's difference20 motivates low/high sign predictions; no equality/zero trial is counted as HOLD unless an actual unique material class is read.
history_references: APD05_MAIN late18 lexical/context panels; not transferred memories from AUX
auditor_only.boundary: This dictionary is for post-commit evaluation only; run() never submits it to request().

panel.transport_contract: request(payload, label) must queue exactly one literal request, wait for its committed terminal receipt, preserve uncertainty and never replay an ID. No direct Store/native path exists in this module.
panel.execution: Serial exante order; no changes in readers/resources/operands based on correctness. Each panel run has its own label prefix supplied by the runner.

sequence_C.initial: Continue actual inherited goal, remaining2 opportunities, real consequences. No reset.
sequence_C.interleave: Basal, after-development and final complete family panels count as material interactions. Fixed literal arithmetic/memory requests between later tasks.
sequence_C.new_declared_teaching: One explicit lexical revision of nara to +1; retain luma and other words as controls. This is not spontaneous consequence learning.
sequence_C.original_a32_return: None. Any later additional consequence link is another declared variant, not original protocol.

observer.default: Passive copies; exact RAW/clocks around decisive windows; sparse native-advance intervals elsewhere.
observer.validation: Same complete prefix and same end, inputs and schedule ON/OFF; compare RAW/clocks plus native pending/receipts and application operational state with identity-only differences declared.

early_E_q4.decision: state>0 and semantic1 and one of the six exact directions: choice=dx; otherwise absent
early_E_q4.source: Geometric prediction from R02 intermediate E and current selector code, before ECI01 Native or reserves

new_reader.classification: Prospective external instrument/P0 readout. No acquired reader selection or equality concept follows solely from it.
new_reader.validation: Discovery loads6/7,7/7,8/7; unchanged reserved loads3/3,11/11,9/7,7/9. No target/operand argument to decoder. NULL remains absent.

attribution.host: Literal requests, opportunity calendar, fixed codecs/readers, modelled environment/effect and post-effect verification; no useful action or correct route supplied.
attribution.DEE: Native reference transformations and emitted signs. A useful acquired policy needs matched history and held-out consequences.
attribution.diagnostic_edits: D-only exact support cuts/swaps and sham; never imported to C or P.

promotion_criteria.failure_of_gate: Keep exact C as complementary experimental life; no automatic promotion or PASS/global mind verdict.
